pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

3. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

4. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

5. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. happiness
   C. quickly
   D. blue

6. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.

7. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

8. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language School.

9. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

10. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

11. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

12. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Phonics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Where is the library?

2. B — One main idea with supporting sentences

3. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

4. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

5. A — run

6. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.

7. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

8. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.

9. D — went

10. A — A person, place, thing, or idea

11. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

12. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Welcome and; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language School; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pre Reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Phonics; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
